item.tib: tshe rab gong nas 'brel ba'i lha/ lha mo srid gsum dbang bsgyur ma/ de yi bka' drin rjes dran pa'i/ gsol 'debs snying gi glu dbyangs
item.coloph: ces ma gcig srid pa'i rgyal mo'i/ bka' drin gsol 'debs gdung shugs snying gi glu dbyangs 'di/ rje drin chen gsang sngags grags pa rin po che'i zhabs nas/ g.yung drung bon la spyod tsam pa'i rnal 'byor yongs kyi ma bgos spyi khyab tu 'gro ba ni/ bka' drin gsol kha go sla la khyer bde ba zhig gyis shig gi bka' brtsal ba dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa la gus pa'i mi dman pa'i mched grogs bka' yis bskul ba thos chung kun grol grags pa bdag gis/ me sbrul hor zla dang po'i 'phel phyogs su dmu rdo g.yung drung spungs rtse'i nub phyogs dbang gi sa skyongs bstan 'dzin rgyal po'i pho brang bsam 'grub seng ge rdzong gi dbu rtse ngo mtshar rab gsal du brtsams pa 'chi med rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
